messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: P0 auth-service token-verify spike — 502s and JWT verification errors. Incident link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:
emily: acked. I'm oncall.
raj: seeing 30% token verify fails from prod logs, jwks-fetch returning 200 but kid not found. stacktraces: 'no matching key for kid "abc123"'.
emily: confirmed. Grafana: auth.verify.errors spiked from 0.2 to 22/s, 502s on /v1/token/validate.
sre-bot: runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/auth-jwt. Steps: check jwks propagation, fallback key, restart auth replicas if necessary.
emily: checking JWKS cache on auth pods.
emily: kubectl exec -n auth -c auth -- curl -s http://localhost:8080/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'
raj: output shows: ["def456","ghi789"] — missing expected 'abc123'
arthur: looks like key-rotate job flipped primary key but didn't update clients. Rolling back to previous signing key in kms?
melissa: KMS shows active key version v3 for signing, previous v2 still present. Signing service maybe rotated but JWKS propagation lagged.
emily: initiating failover to secondary JWKS endpoint and enabling 'accept-previous-key' flag in auth config.
emily: run command:
```
kubectl -n auth set env deploy/auth AUTH_ACCEPT_PREV_KEY=true
kubectl -n auth rollout restart deploy/auth
```
raj: also bumping JWKS cache TTL to 30s temporarily:
```
kubectl -n auth set env deploy/auth JWKS_CACHE_TTL=30
```
pagerduty: INC12345 acknowledged by emily
sre-bot: escalation to SRE lead @oliver due to customer impact >10%
oliver: joining, what's the customer impact?
emily: initial estimate: ~12% token validation failures, mostly interactive flows (SSO) — some enterprise customers seeing login errors. No data exfil or signing compromise detected.
oliver: good. plan: fail open by accepting previous key, short cache TTL, roll back signer to v2 if propagation doesn't stabilize within 15m.
raj: patch applied, auth pods restarting...
emily: logs show "accepted token with old kid abc123" after env flip. error rate halved.
arthur: starting controlled rollback of signer to v2 as precaution.
melissa: informing CS: "we're investigating a partial login outage, mitigation in progress" — sending customer message draft.
cs-draft: "We're aware of an authentication issue affecting sign-in for some users. Engineers are actively mitigating; we'll update within 30 minutes. — CS team"
emily: monitoring grafana — errors down to 3/s, latency normalized.
sre-bot: update: INC12345 status: mitigated -> monitoring
emily: handing off to night oncall @santiago in 25m. leaving runbook steps and TODOs.
santiago: ack, will watch for recurrence and be ready to rollback signer if needed.
melissa: creating post-incident ticket and scheduling follow-up RCA meeting.
emily: adding logs and KMS audit to ticket.
pagerduty: INC12345 resolved by emily
emily: thanks team :team:
